analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Health and employment integration is central to understanding local delivery opportunity and service overlap.
Participant mix and referral routes are important context for workforce design and partnership capacity.
Area-level starts should be interpreted alongside local labour-market and health-related inactivity signals.
